defs.def: an unexpected event, such as a very bad accident, a flood or a fire, that kills a lot of people or causes a lot of damage 灾难；灾祸；灾害

ex.s: Loss of smells can lead to natural disasters.
ex.t: 气味景观的损害可以被人工修复。

ex.s: But as Aristotle observed over 2,000 years ago, actions pushed to their extreme turn into disasters.
ex.t: 但正如亚里士多德在2000多年前观察到的，推向极端的行为会变成灾难。

ex.s: Its author, Dr Henry Petroski, has long been writing about disasters.
ex.t: 其作者亨利·彼得罗斯基博士长期在写关于灾难的内容。

ex.s: Not all disasters are caused by engineering design
ex.t: 并非所有灾难都是由工程设计引起的。

ex.s: The cars that drove the American Dream have helped to create a global ecological disaster.
ex.t: 那些推动了“美国梦”的汽车，却助长了一场全球生态灾难。

ex.s: predict natural disasters           B. protect themselves against insects
ex.t: 预测自然灾害           B. 保护自己免受昆虫侵害

ex.s: predict natural disasters  B.protect themselves against insects
ex.t: 预测自然灾害  B. 抵御昆虫保护自己

ex.s: Mohammed Rezwan saw opportunity where others saw only disaster.
ex.t: 穆罕默德·雷兹万在别人只看到灾难的地方看到了机遇。

ex.s: Now that it’s hard to avoid a disaster on Earth, perhaps I should start thinking about moving to space… 5 “The next station is Bank!” comes the announcement.
ex.t: 既然在地球上很难避免灾难，也许我该开始考虑搬到太空去了…… 5 “下一站是Bank！”广播声传来。

ex.s: Student A: Turn to Page 83 Student B: Turn to Page 86 HURRICANE KATRINA AUGUST 23-31, 2005 It is one of the costliest natural disasters in US history, causing USD 108 billion in damage.
ex.t: 学生A：翻到第83页 学生B：翻到第86页 卡特里娜飓风 2005年8月23-31日 这是美国历史上损失最惨重的自然灾害之一，造成1080亿美元的损失。

ex.s: Although we are surrounded by reminders of the disaster, we are working together to rebuild our homes and our lives.
ex.t: 尽管我们周围都是灾难的痕迹，我们正齐心协力重建我们的家园和生活。

ex.s: Hurricane Safety Guidelines Many people have no idea what to do when a disaster strikes.
ex.t: 飓风安全指南 很多人不知道灾难来临时该怎么做。

ex.s: Etenesh Diro had almost completed two thirds of the 3000m steeplechase, when disaster struck.
ex.t: Etenesh Diro在3000米障碍赛中几乎完成了三分之二的赛程，这时灾难降临了。

defs.def: a very bad situation that causes problems 不幸；祸患
a complete failure 彻底失败的人（或事）
